WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
), status_shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count,
         1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM status_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;
